title: Unique Crispy Mexican Corn Tacos
description: A crispy and citrusy Mexican dish featuring caraway seed and spherified elements, perfect for a lacto-vegetarian meal during the monsoon season, served in a mason jar.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Mix the corn kernels, caraway seeds, lime juice, and olive oil in a bowl.
Spread the corn mixture on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
Allow the corn to cool, then mix with sodium alginate and water to create a spherification bath.
Using a syringe, drop the corn mixture into the bath to create spherified corn pearls.
Rinse the pearls with cold water and set aside.
Heat the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Fry the tortillas in hot oil until crispy and golden brown.
Drain the tortillas on paper towels and fill with the spherified corn, shredded cheese, and chopped cilantro.
Season with salt to taste and serve in a mason jar.
